summary.text: Bob Dohse is the Republican candidate for Arizona House of Representatives District 18 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the July 21, 2026 Republican primary.

A retired U.S. Air Force master sergeant who has lived in Arizona for more than 30 years, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he would focus on fiscal responsibility, economic growth and public safety.

paragraphs.text: Dohse served in the U.S. Air Force from 1976 to 1996, and Ballotpedia lists a high school diploma from Sweetwater Union High School and a bachelor's degree from Park University in 1983.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was raised on a ranch in Wyoming near Yellowstone National Park and in the suburbs of San Diego, and that after his military service he managed humanitarian programs in regions affected by war and civil conflict.
He also said he has served on his homeowners association board and on several national youth leadership development boards.
Dohse said he wants to support small businesses and job growth, maintain public safety and promote education and mentorship for young leaders.
